decision.reason: Sample is small, horizons overlap, and ticker-specific KPI score scales are not directly interchangeable. Preserve current weights until more independent observations accumulate.

limitations: Quarterly event windows overlap, so observations are not statistically independent.
Only three companies are included and each has about twelve events.
Absolute PIT scores use company-specific KPI definitions; pooled score buckets are descriptive only.
Correlation measures association, not causation or forecast reliability.
